item.title: Comment on Germany facts of the day by M
item.description:
Merkel's legacy is in ruins. Can't think of a politician which time has been less kind to.

Abandonment of nuclear power after Fukushima due to green pressure has left German industry in a far more dire position than it needs to be.

Her handling of the Syrian refugee crisis was a direct cause of Brexit and the leaving of an important counterweight within the EU to European bureaucratic/regulatory tendencies. This has been particularly disastrous for Europe in the field of AI. (Not to defend the UK's mainstream parties which have been bouncing from disaster to disaster for decades. The demand for a backdoor to Apple's encryption is just the latest foot target shooting being played by the UK's political class).

The huge reliance on Russian energy was a major contributor to the invasion of Ukraine.

Some hard years ahead for Germany and Europe in general. "The end of history" is over and the EU + UK are flailing badly.
